save_torch_object_storages: save a PyTorch object with storages into a serialized package using _save_storages
load_torch_object_storages: load a serialized PyTorch object with storages from package bytes using _load_storages
get_package_importer: get a cached PackageImporter from a zip reader using _get_package
serialize_deploy_object: serialize a PyTorch object with __reduce_deploy__ for deployment packaging
deserialize_deploy_object: deserialize a previously saved PyTorch deploy object from storage data
